meta.title: Event-group update accepts either policy branch and refuses outside both
gaps: The CSM Procol employee identity cannot be represented; the first buyer update is used as the allowed policy branch proxy.
A user in neither category cannot be represented; the invited vendor is used as the unauthorized-user proxy.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer updates the event with the title set to “QA_Platform_Buyer_…”.
The buyer updates the event with the title set to “QA_Platform_Employee_…”.
The buyer updates the event with the title set to “QA_Platform_Unauthorized_…”.
As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “event group › title” equals the title sent in step 2.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Data check: “event group › title” equals the title sent in step 2.
